online_incident.reported_symptom: OJCHAL v1 followed by native Python traceback-handler segfault and exit code 11
online_incident.corrected_causal_assessment: Removing T.assume did not fix the online crash. The published group_sum ranges and FP16 workspace/output contract establish compact storage and invalidate the earlier padded local fixture.
online_incident.re_enable_optimized_schedule_only_with: successful evidence from the exact online evaluator

synchronized_mechanisms.submission_adaptation: standalone prim-func fixes route weights, private workspace and output to FP16

synchronized_mechanisms.formal: the original benchmark uses M = ceil(group_sum/128) + E metadata blocks

promotion_policy: The local submission gate must reproduce all published remote dimensions, compact group_sum storage, FP16 data/workspace/output and exact INT32 metadata construction before a source can be called submit-ready.
